meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'need, require'.

examples.text: Мы в ваших услугах не нуждаемся.
examples.trans: We do not need your services.

examples.text: Мы в ваших сомнительных услугах больше не нуждаемся.

Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get poisoned', paired with 'отравляться'.
